context.title: Planning context
context.modeAllHint: Plant-wide overview — one lane per crew. Commit requires choosing a target crew.
context.modeCrewHint: Single crew — technician lanes for this crew's roster.
context.crewRequired: Board crew is required to load the calendar and commit work.

filters.teamRequired: Select a board crew to load its calendar
filters.searchPlaceholder: Search backlog by code or title

actions.requiresCommitments: Available once work is committed on this board

backlog.readyHint: Click a Ready card to commit it to the schedule.
backlog.blockedHint: Open a blocked item to clear its blockers in the work order or request.

board.unassignedLane: Team — not yet assigned to a person
board.empty: No assignees or commitments in this horizon.
board.emptyWithCrew: No scheduled work yet — pick a Ready card on the left and commit it to this calendar.
board.emptyAllCrews: No plant commitments in this horizon — pick a Ready card and commit to a target crew.
board.noCrewHint: Use Planning context above to choose All crews or a single crew and the From–To period.

commitment.targetCrewHint: The crew that owns this scheduled work (capacity load and board lane).
commitment.assigneeHint: Optional person who will execute the work. For work orders, they become the primary responsible.
commitment.assigneeDisabledNoCrew: Select a board crew in Planning context before choosing an assignee.
commitment.assigneeDisabledNeedTargetCrew: Select a target crew above before choosing an assignee.
commitment.rosterEmpty: This crew has no members yet.
commitment.rosterEmptyHint: This crew has no members — add people on the crew, or leave Unassigned.
commitment.budgetThresholdHint: Optional ceiling for labor cost. If the calculated estimate exceeds it, a variance warning is recorded.
commitment.estimatedLaborCostHint: An estimate: the job's labour hours (duration × crew size) × the assignee's rate. The server confirms it on commit.
commitment.estimatedLaborCostNeedAssignee: Select an assignee with a rate card, or see the candidate cost range when available.
commitment.estimatedLaborCostNeedSlot: Enter committed start and end to calculate the estimate.
commitment.estimatedLaborCostNoRate: No rate card for this assignee — estimate unavailable until a rate is configured.
commitment.capacityRemaining: Crew capacity this day: {{remaining}} h remaining of {{available}} h.
commitment.noTeamCapacity: This team has no working hours that day: none of its members has a Classe horaire (timetable), or it has no members.
commitment.setUpTeamCapacity: Set up its members' Classes horaires
commitment.capacityBlockedHint: This slot is longer than remaining crew capacity ({{remaining}} h). Shorten the end time.
commitment.capacityDayFull: No remaining crew capacity on this day
commitment.horizonHint: Only dates inside the board From–To period can be selected. Slot length is limited by remaining daily crew capacity.
commitment.horizonPrefillWarning: The candidate window is outside the board period — adjust start and end into From–To before committing.
commitment.previewEmpty: No commitments or leave in this horizon yet.
commitment.previewNeedsCrew: Select a board crew to preview the calendar.
commitment.previewNeedsTargetCrew: Select a target crew to preview where the commitment will land.

errors.crewRequired: Board crew is required to commit.
errors.targetCrewRequired: Select a target crew before committing.
errors.slotRequired: Enter both committed start and end.
errors.slotInvalid: Committed start or end is not a valid date/time.
errors.endAfterStart: Committed end must be after start.
errors.outsideHorizon: Committed start and end must fall inside the board From–To period.
errors.assigneeNotOnCrew: Assignee must be a member of the selected board crew.
errors.capacityExceeded: This slot exceeds remaining crew capacity for that day ({{remaining}} h left). Choose a shorter slot or another day.
errors.budgetInvalid: Budget threshold must be a non-negative number.
errors.capacityExceededDay: Not enough capacity on {{day}}: {{share}} h needed, {{remaining}} h free.

commitment.notEstimated: This work is not estimated: enter its duration and crew size on the work order or the PM before committing it.
commitment.shiftTimeShort: Each person works {{duration}} h, but the slot holds only {{shift}} h of shift time: extend the slot or plan overtime.
commitment.capacityByDay: {{day}}: {{share}} h of this job, {{remaining}} h free of {{available}} h

gantt.emptyCapacity: No capacity data in selected period.

windows.title: Planning windows
windows.equipmentHint: Leave empty for the whole site.
windows.lockedHint: No work can be committed on this site or equipment during the window.
windows.openHint: Open: work that needs the equipment stopped can be placed here (maintenance window, planned shutdown).
windows.scopeReviewHint: This window was created before sites were recorded correctly: it applies to the whole plant until its site is re-entered.

breakIns.title: Break-ins
breakIns.acknowledgeRefusals: Override these refusals with the reason above
breakIns.urgentHint: Urgent reason: name an approver or give a dangerous-override reason.

freeze.title: Freeze schedule period
freeze.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this period must be frozen

override.description: This move conflicts with an existing assignment. Provide an audit reason to continue.
override.assigneeDescription: You are overriding these refusals for this technician. Give the reason; it is logged.

inspector.auditEmpty: No audit entries for this commitment.

deepLink.woNotInBacklog: This work order is not in the planning backlog (not ready to plan yet, already committed or filtered out).

issues.PLANNING_ASSIGNEE_NOT_IN_CREW: Not a member of this crew on the slot's days.
issues.PLANNING_ASSIGNEE_NOT_WORKING: Does not work during this slot.
issues.PLANNING_ASSIGNEE_OVERLOADED: Not enough hours left for this job on one of the days.
issues.PLANNING_DOUBLE_BOOKING: The technician already holds another job at this time (double booking).

assignee.unknownHours_one: {{count}} of their jobs has unknown hours (not counted).
assignee.unknownHours_other: {{count}} of their jobs have unknown hours (not counted).
assignee.unreadableWorkOrders: Planned dates that cannot be read (not counted): {{codes}}.
assignee.othersUnnamed_one: + {{count}} other crew member not named (counted in the crew's load).
assignee.othersUnnamed_other: + {{count}} other crew members not named (counted in the crew's load).

reasons.SKILL_GAP: {{person}} lacks a qualification this job asks for: {{gaps}}.
reasons.ASSIGNMENT_REQUIRED: Name a technician holding the required skills ({{skills}}).
reasons.PERMIT_REQUIRED: A work permit is required and not ready.
reasons.PREREQUISITE_BLOCKED: Waiting for a prerequisite (deferred, or waiting on another job).
reasons.NO_FEASIBLE_WINDOW: Needs the equipment stopped: no open maintenance or shutdown window of its site or equipment over its due dates.
reasons.ASSIGNEE_UNAVAILABLE: The assignee is absent or booked on other work over the due dates ({{availability_conflict_count}}).
reasons.PARTS_SHORT: Parts short in stock: {{articles}}. Order or transfer them before committing.
reasons.PART_NOT_IN_CATALOGUE: Parts not in the article catalogue (stock cannot be checked): {{articles}}.
reasons.PART_QUANTITY_MISSING: Parts without a quantity (stock cannot be checked): {{articles}}.
reasons.PERMIT_TO_REQUEST: A work permit is required and none is requested yet.
reasons.PERMIT_IN_PREPARATION: Permit {{permit_code}} is being prepared ({{status}}); it must be active before the work starts.
reasons.PERMIT_ON_HOLD: Permit {{permit_code}} is suspended ({{status}}); revalidate it before the work starts.
reasons.PERMIT_EXPIRES_BEFORE_WORK: Permit {{permit_code}} expires before the end of the work ({{expires_at}}).
reasons.LOTO_NOT_VERIFIED: LOTO on permit {{permit_code}}: {{verified}} of {{isolations}} isolation points verified; all must be before the work starts.
reasons.LOCATION_UNKNOWN: Location unknown: site windows not checked.

released.hint: The slot is given back: the job returns to the backlog to be scheduled again.

cancelled.hint: The commitment is cancelled and its slot given back. The work itself is not cancelled.

frozenWeek.title: Frozen week: enter as a break-in
frozenWeek.hint: The week of {{week}} is frozen. This job enters it only as a recorded break-in, with its reason.

weekly.title: Weekly schedule
weekly.noPlanningSite: No planning site: in the organisation, a node whose type can own work defines a site.
weekly.frozenWithoutApprovalHint: This week was frozen automatically without approval. A holder of the planning confirm right must approve it; approving after the fact does not change the frozen baseline.
weekly.unfreezePending: Unfreeze requested on {{at}}: {{reason}}. Another planner must decide it.
weekly.unfreezeHint: Another holder of the planning confirm right must approve the unfreeze (four-eyes).
weekly.noCrews: No active crew belongs to this site.

crewsWithoutSite.title: Crew without a planning site
crewsWithoutSite.hint: These crews appear on no weekly schedule: their work is never approved, frozen or published. Attach each crew to an organisation node under a site (a node type that can own work).
crewsWithoutSite.loadFailed: Could not check for crews without a planning site: {{error}}
